Catalog number : M00316 Uniform title: nityākaulatantra Secondary title: nityātantra Manuscript : NGMCP Manuscript No. 2-226 Reel No. B26/21a Description: Description by Mark S.G. Dyczkowski: This is the only manuscript that has been recovered of this Tantra also called Nityātantra. Although just a few badly damaged leaves, the text which is certainly prior to the 10th century represents an important testimony of the early worship of Tripurāsundarī as Tripurabhairavī. This goddess is known to the Kubjikā Tantras that precede the emergence of the well-known śrīvidyā tradition which is centered on the worship of the goddess Tripurāsundarī. She developed out of the pool of Nityā Yoginīs as the most important of them, around which a group of sixteen Nityās are configured in her distinctive yantra, the śrīcakra. This fragment is thus of special importance for the historian of the development of this tradition. Notes: Revision 0: Nov. 15, 2014

padmarāga pratīkāśaṃ taḍintarala saṃnibhaṃ | hṛdgataṃ sādhyanāmaṃ tu saṃcintya dhyānamucyate ||
kāraṇaṃ dhyānayogena (****)(?) yena ca priye | kuṇḍalyākārarūpeṇa cintyācintya sa ucyate ||
na manānyapi maṃtavyo na mantāda (**)(?) rvati | sarva tatva vinirmuktaṃ sarvakārya vivarjitaṃ ||
(**)(?) dhāravinirmuktaṃ sarvakāraṇavarjita | kā (*)(?) karaṇakartavyaṃ rūpādi parivarjitaṃ ||
etad yogavaraṃ śubhraṃ niścintyaṃ tava bhāṣita | yāvat siddhi dvayoraṇyāḥ pratyayāścaiva cātra tu ||
karmāṇi yāni mātrāṇi tatvaṃ pratyā bhavaṃti te | etat saṃkṣepatassāraṃ nityātantramudāhṛtaṃ ||
na śiṣyāya pradātavyaṃ na putrāya kadācana | guru devāgni bhaktāya dātavyaṃ kaulasaṃgrahaṃ ||
anyathā yaḥ prayaccheta sa bhavet siddhinārakaṃ | suparīkṣitā dānād vai sarvasiddhi phalodayaṃ ||
[iti nityākaula pañcamapaṭalaḥ] ||
<12a>
devyuvāca ||
bhagavan sarvamākhyātaṃ yanmayā paripṛcchitaṃ | yantrādhikāraṇaṃ bruhi yogamārga prakautukaṃ ||
bhairava uvāca ||
ādau mṛtyuñjayaṃ vakṣye tava snehāt kṛṣodari | hāntaṃ vindu samāyuktaṃ pa sa madhyagataṃ cayat ||
śāntopari sthitaṃ kāryaṃ bhāntena ca samanvitaṃ | tṛtīyaṃ ka ḹ madhyasthaṃ śṛṣṭivat sahitaṃ kuru ||
vidyāyātyanta saṃyuktaṃ tṛkametat sumadhyame | mahāmṛtyu prasamanaṃ ityupadravanāsanaṃ ||
likhitvā tu mahādevi svanāma sahitaṃ bhuje | kaṇṭhe vā parameśāni dhāraṇā mṛtyujid bhavet ||
amṛtā yā (*)(?) samidhā tṛsaṃdhyoktā yadā tale | na samarthāyamastasyā hiṃsituṃ romameva tu ||
cchalamadhyagataṃ (**)(?) ū pha madhyoparisthitaṃ | vinduyuktā mahādevi hṛllekhā parameśvari ||
mādyayuktāstu trailokya ākarṣaya (**)(?) ṣitaḥ | dha sa madhyagataṃ tatvaṃ cchādyasyoparisaṃsthitaṃ ||
hāntena bhedanaṃ kuryād viṃdu yuktaṃ mahānkuśaṃ | anena (****)(?) veśī vaśaṃ kuryājjagatrayaṃ ||
<12b>
ṭa ḍha madhyagataṃ gṛhya vādyena tu vibheditaṃ | dvitīyaṃ pa na madhyasthaṃ tadante haya madhya (**)(?) ||
(**)(?) taṃ vidyayādyanta paramāpyāyanaṃ smṛtaṃ | na ga madhya sthitaṃ varṇaṃ śṛṣṭikṛt sahitaṃ kuru ||
amṛtī karaṇaṃ proktaṃ (****)(?) pyācca śundari | havanān kurute śānti likhyadhāryaṃ svadehataḥ ||
amṛtī karaṇaṃ proktaṃ kṣīnaye (**)(?) varddhanaṃ | pha ja madhya gataṃ bījaṃ nirviṣīkaraṇaṃ paraṃ ||
ekārādyaṃ mahābījaṃ ādyaṃtaṃ kṛta vidyayā | (*)(?) mbhanaṃ sarva kāryeṣu pītampīto pacārataḥ ||
cchādyaviṃdu samāyuktaṃ vahnimaṇḍalamadhyagaṃ | vidyāyā sahitaṃ bhadre stobhadāghajvarādiṣu ||
māraṇaṃ caiva kartavyā kṣudra karma karā parā | ogamadhyagataṃ gṛhya maṇḍalasthaṃ sa viṃdukaṃ ||
vidyayādyanta saṃyuktaṃ paramuccāṭanaṃ smṛtaṃ | kṛṣṇākṛṣṇopacāreṇa vāyavyāgmukha sthitaḥ ||
phalamadhyagataṃ vartu śāntasyoparisaṃsthitaṃ | sa viṃdukopanaṃ kuryā prīti yukteṣu śundari ||
dampatyo prabhurbhṛtyaiśca prīti yukteṣu nityasaḥ |
<13)
paramaṃ kopa jananaṃ nātra kārya vicāraṇāt | o ṭha madhyagataṃ bījaṃ tadante patitaṃ kuru ||
evamadhyagataṃ bījaṃ yāntaṃ yojya tathā priye | aṃte visarga sahitaṃ mārayet tṛdaśānyapi ||
kalā dvādaśasaṃyuktaṃ sūryamaṇḍalamadhyagaṃ | jvālāmālā kulaṃ dīptaṃ tanmadhye parameśvarī ||
bhidyantī sarvamarmāṇi hṛccakrānta vyavasthitaṃ | karoti paramaṃ stobhaṃ tava samyagudāhṛta ||
ṣoḍaśasvarasaṃyuktaṃ saṃpūrṇaṃ candramaṇḍalaṃ | drutaṃ kanaka saṃkāśaṃ galantu hi na pāṇḍaraṃ ||
cintyā devī mahādevī sarvakāmārtha sādhanī | yadabhīṣṭaṃ (**)(?) na sā cintyā tatva vibhāvayet ||
idānīṃ paramaṃ sāraṃ yogasārasamuccayaṃ | anākhye yantavā (**)(?) tvayā gopyamidaṃ priye ||
yāvanta sarvayogendra rudvā bhairavarūpiṇī | tāvadruccā mahāraktaṃ hṛdaye yo (****)(?) ri ||
etad yogaṃ samākhyāmi mama drohā gurudruhā | kūrmādhāraṃ tu subhage dehamākra yāvati ||
